Description
Experience Swiss excellence with the PAMP 999.0 Pure 1 oz Silver Round, now available through Bullion Trading LLC. Minted in the USA by the esteemed MKS PAMP GROUP, this exquisite silver round embodies precision and quality. Created in a state-of-the-art Florida minting facility and adhering to exacting Swiss standards, this silver round is the epitome of craftsmanship.
This round features a modern yet classic reverse design, with light-reflecting micro-ridges accentuating the iconic PAMP hallmark. Its obverse side showcases a distinctive USA mint mark, setting it apart. Both sides are equipped with advanced, anti-counterfeit micro-engraving, ensuring authenticity and security.
Details:
– Metal: Silver 999.0
– Weight: 1 Ounce
– Thickness: 2.78mm
– Diameter: 39mm
– Design: PAMP
– SKU: SMTB1PAMPUSARND
Each round is securely housed in PAMP-branded plastic tubes containing 20 pieces. Perfect for both investors and collectors, the PAMP 999.0 Pure 1oz Silver Round is a sophisticated addition to any precious metals portfolio.
————————————————————————————————————————————
Add this exceptional silver round to your collection today and experience the unparalleled quality of PAMP.
